event.description:
When: 5:30pm Every Monday

Where: 58 Ballina Road, Lismore NSW, Australia

Category: Regular (Swiss Rounds) - Best of 3

Entry: $17.50 Per Player

Format: Standard Constructed

(The constructed format for Grand Archive is the standard convention for the game: A 60-card main deck with no more than 4 copies of any card, and a material deck capped at 12 unique champion and/or regalia cards.)

Prizes: 2 Standard Booster Packs for participation + Promos packs are handed out by the staff regularly.
event.name: Grand Archive - Monday Nights
